name: ops-capabilities
description: The framework-default capability skills a consumer inherits: ops-integrate (land an approved PR — owns every merge gate and the release-base skip), ops-branching (the repo's branch model, with the integration branches, release base and merge strategy PRIVATE — callers ask for outcomes, never values), ops-ci (CI status + failing-build logs, read-only, provider internal), ops-repo-meta (ambient repo facts as data: identity, topology, live lines), and ops-notify (tell a human). Each is a skill named ops-<capability>, invoked by name with (action, context-json) per catalog.json; a repo overrides one by shipping its own skill of the same name. The two capabilities that are ALWAYS the repo's — ops-change and ops-release — are deliberately absent.
